name: Sentry JavaScript SDK Development
install: curl -fsSL https://get.pnpm.io/install.sh | sh - && export PNPM_HOME="$HOME/.local/share/pnpm" && export PATH="$PNPM_HOME/bin:$PATH" && pnpm runtime set node 24 -g -y && pnpm install

terminals.name: Development
terminals.command: export PNPM_HOME="$HOME/.local/share/pnpm" && export PATH="$PNPM_HOME/bin:$PATH" && echo 'pnpm setup complete. Node version:' && node --version && echo 'pnpm version:' && pnpm --version
terminals.description: Main development terminal with pnpm-managed node
